svg.title: Card 4, stop 4h
svg.text: ON THE WIRES · CLOCK AND DATA
address 0x3C · write · ACK · then 6 bytes per character, ≈ 22 µs a byte
Three places it can be spoiled
Slowed: ≈ 1 ms over I²C at 400 kHz
Clock and data carry it, bit by bit, to the display's pixels
Space: play / stop · ← → step · E eye · C cards
